# Learn with Ian

> Learn with Ian is a free cartoon series on YouTube for children ages 2 to 6. Each short, calm episode teaches one idea (animals, plants, shapes, numbers, colors, weather, holidays). Every episode has a free lesson plan for preschool teachers and a free printable worksheet. Made for Kids on YouTube; no ads or tracking on the website.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://learnwithian.com/): newest episodes, free printables and lesson plans
- [All episodes](https://learnwithian.com/episodes.html): every episode with its topic
- [Free printables](https://learnwithian.com/free.html): a free worksheet for every episode and a free 6-page teacher pack (PDF)
- [Lesson plans](https://learnwithian.com/lessons.html): free circle-time lesson plans for preschool teachers
- [Teacher guide](https://learnwithian.com/teachers.html): how to use the episodes in class
- [Shop](https://learnwithian.com/shop.html): books, printables and T-shirts made from the episodes
- [Episodes in Spanish](https://learnwithian.com/es/) and [in Portuguese](https://learnwithian.com/pt/): lesson plans in Spanish and Portuguese (videos in simple English)

## Episodes
- [Christmas for Toddlers: Ian's Christmas Eve](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-christmas-eve.html): Free printable Christmas activities for preschoolers and toddlers: Christmas Eve sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free 11-minute cartoon and lesson plan.
- [Colors for Toddlers: Ian's Color Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-color-day.html): Free printable color activities for toddlers and preschool: story sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free cartoon that teaches six colors and a lesson plan.
- [Snow for Toddlers: Ian's Snowy Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-snowy-day.html): Free printable winter activities for preschoolers: snowy day sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free cartoon about snow and winter clothes and a lesson plan.
- [How Plants Grow for Kids: Ian's Little Garden](https://learnwithian.com/ep/little-garden.html): Free printable garden activities for preschool: plant story sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free 9-minute cartoon on how plants grow and a lesson plan.
- [Counting 1 to 5 for Toddlers: Ian's Number Walk](https://learnwithian.com/ep/number-walk.html): Free printable counting to 5 activities for toddlers and preschool: story sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free 8-minute counting cartoon and lesson plan.
- [Learn Shapes for Toddlers: Ian's Shape Hunt](https://learnwithian.com/ep/shape-hunt.html): Free printable shapes activities for toddlers and preschoolers: story sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free 9-minute cartoon about circle, square and triangle.
- [Zoo Animals for Toddlers: Ian's Zoo Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/zoo-day.html): Free printable zoo activities for preschoolers and toddlers: story sequencing cards, a picture puzzle and a memory game (PDF), with a free 15-minute zoo animals cartoon and lesson plan.
